product_one_liner.value: Alice provides AI security and safety testing, real-time guardrails, and continuous monitoring for model labs, enterprises, and online platforms building or deploying AI systems.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing or plans page was found in the site navigation or footer; pricing is available by contacting the vendor.

named_customers.notes: These names are explicitly listed under Customers, rather than inferred from partner or investor relationships.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts include Shiri Simon Segal’s production-model distillation implementation and Lior Knaany’s AWS Strands/WonderFence integration; the authors are identified as a senior data scientist and an engineering contributor, respectively.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes WonderSuite and content-moderation user guides, integrations, and API documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Senior AI Engineer is a published vacancy; the careers index also lists Principal Data Scientist and GenAI research roles.

model_provider.notes: Alice explicitly describes using Shield-Gemma as a teacher model to distill smaller models powering WonderFence’s real-time protection; this does not imply every request is sent to Google.

compliance_certs.notes: Only explicitly claimed certifications are included, not regulatory or framework alignment.

last_funding.notes: Announced August 25, 2026. The company announcement gives the amount and date; Dealroom identifies the stage as Series D.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 25, 2026 funding announcement falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Published vacancies include Sales Development Representative and GenAI Account Executive; the latter was independently confirmed on the employer hiring board on November 4, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: On May 20, 2026, Alice introduced the WonderFence FSI Detector Pack, a new suite of financial-services-specific AI guardrails, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Yossi Mizrahi announced joining as VP GenAI on April 6, 2026, within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A business-applications job description explicitly names the GTM stack; the privacy policy additionally names MailChimp and Google Analytics. The business-applications role is no longer open and is used only as stack evidence.
